stubs.body:
At nine, almost every child asks. What matters is the plan you make together.

**Find out what it is for.** Ask Ava what she would use a phone for. Most nine year olds say calls to you and chatting with friends, and both have steps before a phone.

**Give her a plan, with a date on it.** Tell her you are working it out together, what she shows you first, and when you will look again.

Asking for a phone is on Ava's check in now, and in a week I will ask how it went. The words are in [Asking for their own phone](/dashboard/scripts/e9d06c4a-6f50-45f8-a355-b355a39a69fd).

**Tonight.** Ask the one thing she wants a phone for, and just listen.

actions.text: Everyone in her class has a phone. She's 9 and asks every single day.
